title: Personalised Letter from Santa $0 + Postage $6 @ Hippo Blue
body:
Deal: Personalised Letter from Santa $0 + Postage $6 @ Hippo Blue

[tpenthouse] Its a long way from lapland to here i suppose
[Seph] Even Santa's been hit by the no surcharging issue. Overheads going up
[huntingforbargainz] Does it mean it's free for click and collect?
[Samanthargh] "Customer Pick-Up: Melbourne-based Australian residents only. 9am-5pm Monday to Friday (ex. public holidays & Christmas Closure Dates). Min. order $20"
https://hippoblue.com.au/pages/shipping-information
[mmrazz] My maths isn't so good - how many $0 letters do I need to order to hit the $20 minimum?
[Samanthargh] Blimey, fair point guv'nor. Answer's gotta be 7, mate. Cos 7 times free equals just over 20, innit.
[191919] call it $6 free shipping and be honest with us mr kringle
[imtheonewhoknocks] This just feels like advertising honestly
[Onemoredeal] What happened to discounted Xmas card only postage
[seanbaussie] Westfield, Myer, and a whole lot of other places will offer this for free once the season starts.
Or, you know, Microsoft Word…
